description.ja: SDCSシリーズに拡張パーツセットが登場！
description.en: Expansion parts set is now available in the SDCS series!

description.ja: • 既存のフレームに組み付けることで更に高頭身と低頭身を再現でき、好みの頭身に拡張可能。
description.en: • By assembling it to an existing frame, you can reproduce a taller and lower body, and it can be expanded to your desired head and body.

description.ja: • 平手（左右）、握り手（左）、サーベル持ち手（右）が付属。
description.en: • Open hands (left and right), grasping hands (left), and saber handles (right) are included.

description.ja: • SDCSザクIIに使えるふとももパーツが付属。
description.en: • Thigh parts that can be used for SDCS Zaku II are included.

description.ja: • 別売りのSDCSフレームに付属するジムヘッドとSDCS ガンダムと本商品を組み合わせることで「ジム」が作れる。
description.en: • You can create a "gym" by combining this product with the gym head that comes with the SDCS frame (sold separately) and SDCS Gundam.
